decision: Latest official Wine is the final target. Use the verified CodeWeavers baseline only as an intermediate integration reference; port the coherent required macOS graphics integration onto the current pinned upstream source and qualify it with installed Xbox games.

executionPlan: Keep sole Calimocho writer and canonical REQ69/70/72 ownership; record user approval/corrections in the existing SPEC.
Use directly inspected CW26.3 source integration as donor; enumerate coupled macdrv/client-surface/loader/ntdll changes against current pinned Wine before applying patches.
Build a target-architecture complete runtime and test actual graphics ABI; record failures rather than equating module compilation with readiness.
Existing runtime/game owners qualify isolated installed Hogwarts DX12 render/input/quit/relaunch/save; Subnautica2 legal consent remains separate.

why: Vanilla WineHQ 11.20 lacks the inspected macdrv D3DMetal bridge.
The inspected CodeWeavers bridge is LGPL source, not an assumed closed integration layer.
Its callback/window/client-surface/loader integration is broader than three files; wholesale copy into WineHQ is unqualified.
The local Apple evaluation environment explicitly requires a custom Wine translation environment.
A successful WineHQ server-only compile does not supply a loader, graphics path or complete game runtime.

architectureDecision.dependencyPlan: Build required target-architecture dependencies into research-owned paths after precise configure failures; do not use global Intel Homebrew as a speculative prerequisite.

nextBuildProbes: Keep CodeWeavers source pristine and inventory its macdrv, client-surface, loader and ntdll integration as a coherent baseline; do not apply Calimocho's retired D3D11 replacement shim.

Resolve isolated x86_64 FreeType with verified source provenance and compile it before restoring normal font-enabled configure; disclose other missing security/audio/media features rather than silently disabling them.
Compile loader, wineserver, macdrv and required PE modules on the integrated baseline; bind every patch/source/toolchain/artifact identity.
Only after candidate and REQ-71 route admission, run an isolated built-in then a graphics probe with untouched licensed local Apple components; stop on actual ABI/loader errors.
Treat forward-porting the integrated bridge onto WineHQ 11.20 as a measured follow-on. Do not claim latest-Wine delivery from a Wine 11.0 compatibility baseline.

publicResearchLimitations: First public-research report contained contradicted claims about GPTK4, published CodeWeavers integration, licensing and private Xbox route readiness; those claims were rejected.
Correction pass verified Apple's GPTK4 page and retracted blanket closed-source and no-redistribution claims.
No exact attributable public Subnautica 2 Xbox success record was verified in this research pass; absence of found public reports is not incompatibility.
No current native-ARM CrossOver shipping capability or social-report matrix was independently qualified.
Use primary local source/artifact evidence for build decisions; additional community anecdotes cannot substitute for actual candidate testing.
